note: Typed extras in search and in the readable copies (kinds PR 6, S4b-BL-210; docs/03 ADR-36 §18.10), read by both stacks: the website's kind-search.spec.ts and the phone's KindSearchVectorsTest (:shared) and HouseListSearchTest (:ui). The candidate is school-vectors.json's `candidate` (a school with all seven extras). `searched`: the extras school.json's `search` names (the house's search list is unchanged and its extras all have a `was`, so a house gains no word). `search.<lang>`: the words a school's extras add to the list search, in order, after every word it had before (the kind file's order of extras; an enum's option and a switch's label in English, then in the app's language when that is not English and the words differ; a number's digits; a text as typed; money as its digits and as rupees). `invalid`: extras of the wrong type or out of the kind's options add no word and no copy row, and a switch that is off adds no word but is written as the copy's *No* (`invalid.copies`, in English). `flagOff`: with the developer flag off a school is drawn, searched and copied as a house, so it adds no word and no copy row or column. `copies.<lang>`: each extra with a value, in the kind file's order, as the readable copies (HTML, Markdown, the phone's PDF) write it (`text`, on the Details block before *Added*), as the CSV writes it (`cell`, a column per extra of each kind in the copy, after *Floor*) and the XLSX cell type (`xlsx`: text, number, or money with the rupee format). The label of a row and a column is the field's label in the copy's language, per stack: school-vectors.json `kind.labels.<stack>.<lang>["field.<id>"]`. A copy with no school has no extra column (the house copies are pinned by house-pins.golden.ts and HouseCopyPinsTest). Change a case only with the change it pins; hi, ta and te are under review.
